<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral Integrity:</strong> Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar has pledged that all complaints regarding name deletions will be resolved before the next Lok Sabha elections to ensure voter accuracy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative Business:</strong> The Lok Sabha has officially commenced discussions on the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation (Amendment) Bill, 2026, marking a significant step in regional governance policy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOZ3NyRmdBaFBqMXpvbFZ3blhmVWozVDlKRkprVUdsSGhGbFVWdFBjeFk4WFh2ckhLb2FiSGhMVF82YVdoeWkyaHBiLTc0RlBZcTg2WEhXdzkyWlFSYzZSZkZzTTlseDhqZ3JDdHRMUjFkNDRDTDZUMFhpQ3dGMGpyQm5QdVlDR05DS0Nyb05xU2cyVXFtVmZYWXZQZmozV1FPU3dEdmVwTDlfUkh0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political Funding Reforms:</strong> The Congress party has introduced a new mandate requiring ticket seekers to hold ₹20 lakh in their bank accounts to streamline party funding ahead of the 2027 polls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Internal Party Discipline:</strong> The Bihar Congress disciplinary committee has issued show-cause notices to 29 party leaders, signaling a move to tighten internal organizational control.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Infrastructure Advocacy:</strong> BJP MLAs in Telangana utilized tractor protests at the Assembly to demand the urgent implementation of the Fasal Bima Yojana for farmers.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
</ul>
